title: Crypto-Cash Back: Security and Safety of Crypto Redemptions
summary: Covers security and safety practices for Crypto-Cash Back redemptions: purchase protection is No; verify the exact public address/network, include required memo/tag correctly, use saved verified addresses, enable redemption-confirmation notifications, and lock/pause redemptions if you suspect unauthorized access. Also instructs to monitor wallet/app transaction confirmations and keep redemption records for reconciliation/tax reporting.
faqs: Does this Crypto-Cash Back card have purchase protection for crypto redemptions?

If my wallet needs a memo/tag, what happens if it’s missing or incorrect?
How can I detect unexpected or unauthorized redemption activity?
What should I do after redeeming—how do I verify confirmation status?
